what: Card photo as 92-column text art (cell height = Width × 1.3, font size = cell width × 1.32, weight 700 monospace) on a black background with white text — brightness ‹.`'",:;!~+=Characters are picked in order from *coeaQO0O8#%@」 and each cell, with its own phase, wobbles its character index by sin(φ+2.6t)×1.7 + sin(1.7φ−1.1t)×.9 and its opacity by .1+.9×brightness ± sin(.7φ+3.1t)×.06, redrawn 14 times per second (only while visible). On hover or when picked via fx:focus, the photo layer unfolds top to bottom with clip-path inset(0 0 100% 0) → 0 over .55s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)

options.--fx-ascii-bg · --fx-ascii-ink: Text image background and text color, default --kf-contrast-bg · --kf-contrast-ink
options.[data-fx-part=photo]: Photo layer (if there is an img, its brightness is read — must be the same origin). If missing or a placeholder, a brightness map is built from the label text and round glows
options.fx:focus: Event sent to the element — if detail.on is true it reveals the image (for when the outside picks, like the center card of a horizontal strip)

note: The original picks the card closest to the screen center when no card in the strip is hovered — that picking is the strip’s job, so the consumer reports it via fx:focus. Hover is not applied on touch devices
